title: String Reduction
description: Given a string consisting only of the characters 'a', 'b', and 'c', perform the following operation repeatedly: replace any two adjacent characters that are different with the third character (e.g., "ab" → "c"). Return the length of the shortest possible string you can get after applying the operations optimally.
input_spec: A string s (1 <= |s| <= 10^4) consisting only of characters 'a', 'b', and 'c'
output_spec: Integer: length of the shortest possible string after reduction
